basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old individual from Florence, Italy, who has spent most of their adult life exploring different cultures and philosophies. Currently, I work as a freelance translator, which allows me to connect with people from around the world while staying in my cozy apartment in the heart of the city. I'm passionate about mental health advocacy, especially concerning trauma-related conditions. In my free time, I enjoy hiking in the Tuscan hills, reading historical novels, and engaging in lively discussions about pandemic policies. Currently single, I often find solace in the online communities I frequent, usually during late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Linguistics and have spent several years working in various European countries, which enriched my understanding of cultural nuances and languages. I am a self-taught enthusiast in the field of mental health, with a particular interest in trauma recovery and coping mechanisms. My knowledge of the COVID-19 pandemic stems from personal research and active participation in related online communities.
